remarks: Ground floor/walk out two bedroom deluxe suite. This is a type "H" layout and offers a breakfast bar and larger dining room table/living room combo. Ownership gives you 10-11 rotating weeks a year, or about 1 week per month. Additional time is available on a Space Available basis. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated pool, hot tubs, sauna, fitness room, valet parking, underground parking while lodging overnight, private owner locker rooms and private owner's lounge. Discounts are available on daily lift tickets as well as golf.
